# ise_sxp_vpn (Resource)

This resource can manage a SXP VPN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ise_sxp_vpn" "example" {
  sxp_vpn_name = "SXPVpn1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sxp_vpn_name` (String) The name of the SXP VPN domain, for example `default`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the SXP VPN.
- `name` (String) The name of the SXP VPN.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ise_sxp_vpn.example "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
```
